name: CHEAT_INVINCIBLE
comment: read_keys has a disabled key toggle of the invincible flag ($4080): LDA #$78 / BNE always skips it. The patch puts AND #$78 there, so holding F1, F3, F5 and F7 together toggles invincibility. No release has this byte: the patch is a reconstruction.

name: CRACK_DR_BOOT
comment: Derbyshire Ram boot code with a CBM80 header at $8000 (in the map buffer): builds the $d100 table, the $0200 routine and the loader values, then jumps to $4000. The map buffer overwrites its end.

name: CRACK_DR_BOOT
comment: Derbyshire Ram boot code with a CBM80 header at $8000, in the map buffer: builds the $d100 table, the $0200 routine and the loader values at $1100/$1130/$1142, jumps to $8100, which copies $1100-$11ff to $0300 and jumps to $4000. The map rows of play write over it.

name: EDITION_SYNSOFT
comment: The title line of the DR release reads "COPYRIGHT 1983 SYNSOFT" (centred) in place of "COPYRIGHT 1983 SYNAPSE SOFTWARE". Synsoft is the label of the U.S. Gold editions of Synapse games.

name: EDITION_SYNSOFT
comment: The title line of the DR release reads "COPYRIGHT 1983 SYNSOFT" (centred) in place of "COPYRIGHT 1983 SYNAPSE SOFTWARE". No other game byte differs for this.

name: PROTECTION_LOADER_CHECK
comment: F3 during play sets fkey_code 2. The main loop then wants 4 in $0342, a value the original loader leaves in the tape buffer. Any other value starts the rank screen: the game ends. ANON ($c8) and BANDIT ($00) fail the check, DR (4) passes.

name: PROTECTION_LOADER_CHECK
comment: F3 during play sets fkey_code 2. The main loop then wants 4 in $0342, a value of the original loading (the Bandit dump of a running game has it). Any other value starts the rank screen: the game ends. ANON ($c8) and BANDIT ($00) fail the check, DR (4) passes.

name: PROTECTION_TABLE
comment: The original loader leaves an identity table (00..ff) at $d100, in the RAM under the I/O area. The game copies it to $1000 at $5ed8 and reads it there. The anonymous crack (base) puts the table at $1000 itself and writes NOP over the store at $5eea.

name: RUN_STATE_BANDIT
comment: Values that a game that ran left in the image of the Bandit memory dump: variables, self-modified operands of the scroll code and the map buffer at $8000.

name: RUN_STATE_DR
comment: Values that a game that ran left in the image of the Derbyshire Ram release: variables and self-modified operands.

name: TRAINER_BOMBS
comment: Derbyshire Ram trainer "BOMBS CHEAT?": LDA in place of DEC of the bomb counter.

name: TRAINER_FUEL
comment: Derbyshire Ram trainer "FUEL CHEAT?": LDA in place of DEC of the fuel counter.
